items.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: So me and Wendell Cully, we walked out to the plane and looked in, and we see all these parachutes on the seats

ctx.x: Did they finally—something finally happened because you’re here with us.

So we get to Corpus Christi, Texas. Now, so finally we land. Everybody set there about 15 minutes before they got out of the plane. It was quiet — boy you could hear a mouse — quiet you know. So everybody started getting out one by one, taking off the parachute, taking their instruments and go outside. We got outside, and we had to play under some trees. We get out there, and set up under these trees out there, in the hot summertime. Oh, man, it looked like a big field. And people, as far as you could see. And…

That’s great. You know what I’d like to do here, is I know our driver is waiting for you— MK: Oh, he’ll wait as long as he needs to. We just don’t want to tire you out after we left you in the lobby for 45 minutes.
